tooling: console at console.rarecloud.io with full root, custom ISO and instant activation; the site links to an API reference at console.rarecloud.io/docs/api/ and serves an llms.txt (link read, API contents not read); a custom-size deploy page lets CPU, RAM, storage and bandwidth be picked separately
chaining: EUR 19.50 a year for a 768 MB KVM box in three US cities is the cheapest US presence, and the per-resource custom deploy page is the only one here that lets RAM be bought without disk. It is a DNS, monitoring or scheduler box: 1024 GB a month is roughly 34 GB a day, which is a narrow crawl and nothing like a serving path.
